correctness.rationale: From actual RESULT.md, the P1 nodal Gram matrix satisfies 6M=2D+A; its two symmetry classes give explicit M^-1 rows. Integrating |affine endpoint kernel| uses J(s,t), and both branches m<=2k and m>2k have strictly positive coefficient-polynomial numerators Q_- and Q_+ for R_I-R_C. Their all-parameter positivity, not finite samples, proves the only norming vertices; affine convexity rules out interiors. The stated formula implies R_I-2=(m^2+2km-5m-8k+8)/[3L(L+1)], giving m>=4, and (7/3)-R_I>0. Independently constructed numerical Gram-matrix inverses and kernel absolute integrals for 72 (m,k) pairs showed maximum formula error 8.89e-15, strict class comparison, and threshold.
